author: heidi diedrick
text: G&L Septic always services our home well. Love the friendly greeting when I call to make the appointment because they know their customer and my tank!  Chad offers advice when I ask questions and the reminder postcards to book service keeps my home running smoothly and without damage from a bad or overfull tank. I never even know they’re there doing what they came to do!  Great service and I trust no one else.

author: M R
text: Our septic was on the verge of flooding. G & L took the time to come out and drain the tank, and then worked with my schedule to return 2 weeks later to clear out a badly blocked pipe. We were worried the situation was worse, but Chad and his crew worked the blockage and managed to clear it out. They were very professional, reasonable, honorable, and kind. It was a relief to have found them. They came highly recommended, and it's easy to see why. Thank you to Chad & his crew.

author: Beth Jones
text: Great communication! Explained the process to me thoroughly and they were able to complete the process while we were at work. It was easy to set up the appointment and get the job done. G&L Septic is a reliable company. I appreciate the ease of the whole process.

author: Ashley
text: Easy company to work with.  They did a nice job communicating, they were punctual, and respectful.  Fair pricing.

author: Larry Folk
text: G&L have been servicing my septic system for twenty years, always excellent service at a fair price. Recently, the main drain line between the house and the tank broke. G&L did an excellent job digging up and replacing the broken section, releveling the pipe on a new bed of gravel and refilling the trench. They accomplished this project in a few hours at a very reasonable price.
